# FDG8036

> AVOID implementing collection interfaces on types with complex APIs unrelated to the concept of a collection.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.3.4 Implementing Custom Collections.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

Not machine-checkable: whether a type's API is complex and unrelated to a collection is judgment.

## From the book

In other words, a collection should be a simple type used to store, access, and manipulate items, and not much more.
